code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, and thrombocytopenia, with elevated erythrocytes, ferritin, INR, potassium, chloride, and basophils. Glucose is slightly low. Liver enzymes (ALT, AST) are low but not clinically significant. Elevated ferritin and mild CRP may indicate inflammation. The findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or systemic inflammation; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
